title: FORGE suggestion promotion proposal
description: Closed proposal that turns accepted suggestions into a downstream patch. Each entry names the exact proposed record, its digest, and the destination contract validator that accepted it in-process. The proposal records its own unapproved status, and the destination artifact is never written. Runtime validation additionally rejects decoded duplicate keys, nulls, an empty or over-long entry list, a repeated suggestion, and an entry whose contract is not the destination's.
$comment: Runtime enforces a 2 MiB byte limit, depth 32, at most 1000 entries, 1 MiB per proposed record, lowercase SHA-256 digests, canonical lowercase UUIDs and portable descendant paths. Only accept-as-is and accept-edited suggestions are ever promoted.

kind.$comment: A mapping manifest is validated with forge.mapping-manifest/1; an authoring pack with forge.authoring-pack/1.

status.$comment: Promotion is always a proposal; no other value can be written or read.

contract.$comment: Must equal the destination kind's contract.
